mentions.name: struktur
mentions.description: An all-in-one command-line tool for structured data extraction with LLMs. It prepares documents (e.g., converting PDFs to text), runs multiple extraction strategies, and executes a full in-process agent loop for data extraction using Pi agent and just-bash.dev, supporting actions like grepping through large files. Usage example: struktur extract —input doc.pdf —schema schema.json —model openai/gpt-5.
